formulas.tex: \term{probability}{p_{ab\mid c}} = \frac{\term{count}{n_{abc}}}{\term{rowTotal}{n_{ac}}}, \quad n_{abc} = \#\{(t, i) : x_{t,i} = a,\ x_{t+1,i} = b,\ \term{lagClass}{\mathrm{class}(L_{t,i})} = c\}, \quad \term{lag}{L_{t,i}} = \frac{\sum_j w_{ij}\, y_{t,j}}{\sum_j w_{ij}}
formulas.ascii: p_ab|c = n_abc / n_ac; n_abc = #{(t, i): class(t, i) = a, class(t + 1, i) = b, lag class of L(t, i) = c}; L(t, i) = sum_j w_ij y(t, j) / sum_j w_ij over the included neighbours (normalize = true). Lag classes use one set of breaks pooled over all periods. p = 0 for a (c, a) state without transitions.
